examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Two linked cards on the default two-column grid. The frame belongs to the group; the hairline between the cells is the shared 1px gap, painted by the cells themselves.

examples.name: Columns
examples.summary: The `cols` axis at three: one column on a phone, two at the small breakpoint, three at the large one. The ring-per-cell rules stay correct at every width, and an incomplete last row is simply empty rather than a rule-coloured hole.
